name: FA_RETIREMENTS_T
description: FA_RETIREMENTS_T contains temporary storage data for retirement transaction.

columns.name: BATCH_NAME
columns.description: Unique user-defined name for a batch of records in the interface table.  Free text field.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Oracle Fusion Enterprise Resource Planning: request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: WORKER_ID
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Internal identifier for parallel processing.

columns.name: RETIREMENT_INTERFACE_ID
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Retirement interface identifier.

columns.name: RETIREMENT_ID
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Retirement identifier.

columns.name: BOOK_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Asset book. Use the Manage Asset Books task to identify valid values.

columns.name: POSTING_STATUS
columns.description: Posting status. Valid values: NEW, POST, ON HOLD. NEW means the asset information is new. POST means the asset is ready to be posted. ON HOLD means the row needs further review.

columns.name: ASSET_ID
columns.description: Asset identifier. Use the Asset Inquiry in any  work area to identify a valid value.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_NAME
columns.description: Transaction description. Free text field. Not validated.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_TYPE
columns.description: Retirement transaction type. Valid values: COST RETIRE, UNIT RETIRE, SRCLINE RETIRE, REINSTATEMENT, GROUP ADJUSTMENT.COST RETIRE means cost retirement. UNIT RETIRE means unit retirement. SRCLINE RETIRE means source line retirement. REINSTATMENT means reinstatement of the asset. GROUP ADJUSTMENT means group adjustment.

columns.name: DATE_RETIRED
columns.description: Retirement date. Date format: YYYY/MM/DD.

columns.name: COST_RETIRED
columns.description: Amount of cost retired from the asset.  Enter without thousands separator. Use either comma or period as decimal separator.

columns.name: RETIREMENT_CONVENTION_TYPE_ID
columns.description: Retirement convention type identifier. Use the Manage Prorate Conventions task to identify valid values.

columns.name: COST_OF_REMOVAL
columns.description: Removal cost. Enter without thousands separator. Use either comma or period as decimal separator. Cannot be negative.

columns.name: PROCEEDS_OF_SALE
columns.description: Amount received from the sale of an asset. Enter without thousands separator. Use either comma or period as decimal separator. Cannot be negative.

columns.name: RETIREMENT_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Retirement type. Use the Manage Fixed Assets Lookups, lookup type FA_RETIREMENT_TYPES to identify valid values.

columns.name: REFERENCE_NUM
columns.description: Retirement reference number. Free text field. Not validated.

columns.name: SOLD_TO
columns.description: Sold to name. Free text field. Not validated.

columns.name: TRADE_IN_ASSET_ID
columns.description: Trade in asset identifier. Use an Assets work area to identify valid values.

columns.name: STL_METHOD_ID
columns.description: Straight line depreciation method identifier. Use the Manage Depreciation Methods task to identify valid values.

columns.name: STL_DEPRN_AMOUNT
columns.description: Straight line depreciation amount for reporting of 1250 property in a tax book. Enter without thousands separator. Use either comma or period as decimal separator.

columns.name: RECOGNIZE_GAIN_LOSS
columns.description: Indicates whether gain or loss on retirement must be recognized. Valid values: Y, N.

columns.name: REDUCTION_RATE
columns.description: Depreciation reduction percentage for the asset group. Must be between 0 and 100.

columns.name: RESERVE_RETIRED
columns.description: Depreciation reserve reduced by retirement. Enter without thousands separator. Use either comma or period as decimal separator. Must be less than depreciation reserve.

columns.name: EOFY_RESERVE
columns.description: Depreciation reserve at the end of the fiscal year. Enter without thousands separator. Use either comma or period as decimal separator.

columns.name: PREPARER_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the person who prepared the mass addition record. Use the Manage resources task to identify valid values.

columns.name: INTERFACE_LINE_NUMBER
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Interface line number.

columns.name: LOAD_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Oracle Fusion Enterprise Resource Planning: process ID of the loader job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. Incremented every time the row is updated. Compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
